options.name: init_config
options.description: All options defined here are available to all instances.

options.name: instances
options.description: Every instance is scheduled independently of the others.

options.name: collectors
options.description:
A list of resource types to collect

Example to enable pods and nodes collectors:

options.name: label_joins
options.description:
label_joins allows adding the tags to join from other KSM metrics.

Example: Joining for deployment metrics. Based on:
kube_deployment_labels{deployment="kube-dns",label_addonmanager_kubernetes_io_mode="Reconcile"}
Use the following config to add the value of label_addonmanager_kubernetes_io_mode as a tag to your KSM
deployment metrics.

options.name: labels_as_tags
options.description: labels_as_tags allows to specify custom labels of kubernetes resources to be turned into Datadog tags attached the corresponding metrics.

options.name: annotations_as_tags
options.description: annotations_as_tags allows to specify custom annotations of kubernetes resources to be turned into Datadog tags attached the corresponding metrics.

options.name: labels_mapper
options.description:
LabelsMapper can be used to translate kube-state-metrics labels to other tags.
Example: Adding kube_namespace tag instead of namespace

options.name: tags
options.description:
A list of tags to attach to every metric and service check emitted by this instance.

Learn more about tagging at https://docs.datadoghq.com/tagging

options.name: disable_global_tags
options.description: disable_global_tags disables adding the global host tags defined via tags/DD_TAG in the Agent config, default false.

options.name: namespaces
options.description:
namespaces contains the namespaces from which we collect metrics

 Example: Enable metric collection for objects in prod and kube-system namespaces.

options.name: resync_period
options.description: resync_period is the frequency of resync'ing the metrics cache in seconds, default 5 minutes (kubernetes_informers_resync_period).

options.name: telemetry
options.description:
enables telemetry check's metrics, default false.
Metrics can be found under kubernetes_state.telemetry

options.name: skip_leader_election
options.description:
skip_leader_election forces ignoring the leader election when running the check
Can be useful when running the check as cluster check
